senses.gloss: (cmp. כסח) to make incisions, mark, count. Part. pass. כָּסוּי marked, distinguished.
units: Pesik. R. s. 39 (ref. to Ps. LXXXI, 4, v. כֶּסֶא) מהו בכסא בחדש שהוא כ׳ (not כיסוי) what is bakkesé? In the month which is marked (v. infra).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 29:6">Lev. R. s. 29</cite> (ref. to Ps. l. c.) <he>וכל החדשים אינן נִכְסִין אלא ליום חגנו</he> are all other months (or New Moon Days) not marked?—But (it must be marked by) ‘a festive day’; [read:] <he>חגו בפני עצמו והלא ניסן חדש נִכְסֶה ויש לו חג</he>: (Ar. … <he>חדש ונתכסה</he>) but is not Nisan a marked month with a festival? (Answ.) Its festival is separate from it (not coinciding with the New Moon Day); <he>אלא איזהו חדש נ׳ ויש לו חג וכ׳</he> but what month is there that is marked and has a festival, and that on the same day?; Pesik. Baḥod., p. 153ᵃ
